theorem_title: Alon's matching lower bound: $\Omega(n^{2/3})$ is attained
natural_language_statement:
For some $c > 0$ and every $n$, there are $n$ unit vectors, two orthogonal among any three, whose sum has norm at least $cn^{2/3}$.

With Konyagin's upper bound, this makes the answer to Lovasz's problem $\Theta(n^{2/3})$.
source: Noga Alon, "Explicit Ramsey graphs and orthonormal labelings", Electron. J. Combin. 1 (1994) R12, doi:10.37236/1192, https://doi.org/10.37236/1192
